name: Victor Antos Email Verifier CLI
free_limit: Free MIT-licensed Python CLI for local CSV email validation using syntax, MX and SMTP RCPT checks; no software-imposed usage quota or expiration.
watch_out: Requires Python 3.9+, DNS/network access and outbound SMTP port 25; large mailbox providers may return unknown results, and bulk SMTP probing may violate provider policies or local law. Run only on addresses you are authorized to verify; infrastructure and network costs are not included.
